summary:
All seven Done-when items hold. I checked them against real folders on this PC, not only the unit tests. A scratch console compiled the slice's src/FsAnalyser.App/UnreadableRows.cs against the built HEAD Core and ran the real Scanner.Scan on four targets:
- C:\ProgramData, completed: 570 record entries, 570 rows
- %TEMP%, completed: 43 rows (13× code 5, 28× 363, 2× 1920)
- C:\ProgramData stopped at 0.7 s: status Cancelled, 67 rows
- C:\Windows stopped at 20 s: status Cancelled, 51 rows

On every run the checker found zero problems:
- The row paths match the record's paths one to one, and each row carries its record's kind and code.
- Every path is full, and consecutive rows are strictly in ComparePaths order.
- The stamped kind always equals the ChildCount rule.
- Reasons are never empty and always one line. Code 5 reads "access denied". Codes 363 and 1920 show Windows' message followed by "(Windows error N)".

As a separate check, this harness (not the view) tried to list every "could not be opened" row. All 570, 67 and 51 real code-5 folders were refused. The 363 and 1920 folders failed again with IOException.

I republished the exe from HEAD. Run on C:\ProgramData it reports status Completed and the header "Unreadable folders (570)". Window case S-007 (12,345 real denied folders) passed. The full suite passed 478/478. Fitness holds all 67 rules. Plants F27, F28 and F29 fire in both engines, and rules-parity reports AGREE.

The verdict is partial, not passes, because two fixes that code review assigned to build-slice are still missing from the tree:
- **O-022:** rule 2's pattern is unchanged in both fitness.yaml:249 and ArchitectureRulesTests.cs:216, and there is still no three-line plant.
- **O-023:** it still reproduces. Sorting [readme\x, README\y, readme, README] under C:\cs gives "README | readme | readme\x | README\y", so a folder's descendants are split apart when a sibling differs only in case.

Also unchecked: criterion 8 (a folder that opened, then failed before its first entry) has no test, and I could not produce that shape. No real partly-read folder occurs on this PC, so "only partly read" is exercised only through the failpoint test on a real temp tree. The index shows a single build attempt, so the slice is not looping.

planned.evidence: Unit: ANothingListedAndAPartwayEntryGiveOneRowEachWithTheirOwnKind and AnEntryRecordedThreeTimesIsOneRowWithItsFirstKindAndCode (entry 4 three times gives one row with the first kind and code; paths looked up once each) pass in the 478-test suite. Real: the harness compared the rows one to one against the engine's record on four real scans: 570/570, 43/43, 67/67 and 51/51. Row path sets equal the record path sets, each row carries its record's kind and code, and every path is fully qualified. The engine never recorded an entry twice in reality, so repeats are exercised only by the unit test

Unit: TenThousandAndFiftyShuffledEntriesAreAllListedInPathOrder (10,050 rows, same set, strictly ordered) passes. Real: consecutive rows are strictly in ComparePaths order on every scan, with no cap (570 rows; the S-007 window has 12,345 folders). There are no grouping or 'N more' rows because Build returns only record rows. Caveat (O-023, still open): the order keeps a folder's descendants beside it except when a sibling differs from it only in case. The order stays total and deterministic, so 'sorted by path' holds

The kind is stamped in Scanner.FolderDone from ChildCount>0 on the record, and UnreadableRows.KindText reads it from the record. The record's constructor is internal, so the App cannot build or re-kind one. Real: every stamped kind on four scans equals the ChildCount rule, and the harness's own re-list confirmed all 688 real code-5 'could not be opened' rows are refused. 'Only partly read' is exercised only by the failpoint test on a real temp tree; no real partway folder exists on this PC. Known limit, decided by the person (M2): a folder that opened and then failed before its first entry is recorded NothingListed

ACodeOfAPlainFamilyGetsItsPhrase: 22 InlineData rows (5, 65 / 32, 33 / the 18 network codes including 59 and 64). Each checks the exact phrase, that no number appears, and that Windows has a message for the code; all pass. Real: all 701 code-5 rows across the four scans read 'access denied'. The sharing and network codes were not met on real folders

AnotherCodeGetsWindowsOwnMessageAndItsNumber over 2, 362, 363, 1920, 1921 and 4390-4394 passes. Real rows under %TEMP%: 'The cloud file metadata is corrupt and unreadable. (Windows error 363)' ×28 and 'The file cannot be accessed by the system. (Windows error 1920)' ×2. The display-language part was observable only on an en-US machine (see not_reached)

ACodeWithNoMessageStillNamesItsNumber (9999, 15999, 65535) and AnEmptyOrBrokenSystemMessageStillGivesAOneLineReason (null, empty, whitespace and CR/LF lookups give 'no description from Windows (Windows error 4390)') pass. EveryCodeUpTo16000HasAOneLineReasonAndOutsideThePhrasesNamesItsCode passes in the default suite. Real rows: no empty reason on any of the 731 rows

The fitness.yaml entry 'TheUnreadableViewTouchesNoFileSystem (*.cs)' is scoped to src/FsAnalyser.App/UnreadableRows.cs. Its xUnit twin, ArchitectureRulesTests.TheUnreadableViewTouchesNoFileSystem, is green. Plants F27 (File.Exists) and F28 (Path.Exists) fire in both engines, AS-RECORDED, while the file's Win32Exception lookup stays quiet (clean baseline 0 hits). Fitness op=check holds all 67 rules and rules-parity reports AGREE

criteria.criterion: 1. list the failed folders — when the record holds one not-opened entry and one partly-read entry
criteria.how: The unit test ANothingListedAndAPartwayEntryGiveOneRowEachWithTheirOwnKind passes. On real scans, 731 rows across four roots matched their records one to one (all NothingListed; no real partway entry exists here)

criteria.criterion: 2. list the failed folders — when the same Entry appears three times, with a different code and kind on the repeats
criteria.how: The unit test AnEntryRecordedThreeTimesIsOneRowWithItsFirstKindAndCode passes. On real scans, record count equalled distinct entries on all four, so the engine never repeats an entry

criteria.criterion: 3. sort the rows — when 10,050 entries in shuffled order (U-104 shape)
criteria.how: The unit test TenThousandAndFiftyShuffledEntriesAreAllListedInPathOrder passes. The real window case S-007 with 12,345 denied folders passed

criteria.criterion: 4. sort the rows — when sibling names that straddle the separator: 'a', 'a\b', 'a b', 'a.b', 'd1\x' vs 'd10'
criteria.how: The Theory SiblingsThatStraddleTheSeparatorSortAfterTheFolderAndEverythingInIt passes. On real rows, strict ComparePaths order held on every scan

criteria.criterion: 5. sort the rows — when two paths that differ only in letter case (a case-sensitive directory)
criteria.how: PathsThatDifferOnlyInCaseSortTheSameWhateverTheRecordOrder passes: two or more case-variant paths get one deterministic order. The wider shape in O-023 still fails when measured: README | readme | readme\x | README\y. That breaks the design's 'descendants directly under their folder' claim, and it is owed to build-slice

criteria.criterion: 6. record which kind of failure happened — when a real temp folder whose open is refused by a deny ACL
criteria.how: UnreadableFolderTests asserts (entry, 5, NothingListed) on a real deny-ACL temp tree and passes. Real: all 570+67+51+13 code-5 folders are stamped NothingListed, and the harness's own listing attempt was refused for every one

criteria.criterion: 7. record which kind of failure happened — when a real temp tree whose listing fails partway via the ScanFailingPartway failpoint (U-103 shape)
criteria.how: The UnreadableFolderTests partway test (failpoint on a real temp tree: ListedPartway/995 with 1..1999 children) passes in the suite. No natural partway failure occurred on real scans here, so this is code contact only

criteria.criterion: 8. record which kind of failure happened — when the folder opened but its listing failed before any entry came back
criteria.how: There is no test, and I could not produce the shape. By construction (ChildCount==0) such a folder is NothingListed ('could not be opened'), which is the documented limit the person chose (M2). Whether the 28 real code-363 rows are in this shape is unmeasured

criteria.criterion: 9. list the failed folders — when the scan was stopped while a folder was being listed
criteria.how: Two real stopped scans (status Cancelled: C:\ProgramData at 0.7 s, C:\Windows at 20 s) gave 67 and 51 rows, one to one with their records, sorted, with no row caused by the stop (all code 5, all confirmed refused). I did not control the exact moment of stopping mid-listing of one large folder

criteria.criterion: 10. give a readable reason — when each code in the three plain families (22 codes)
criteria.how: The 22-row Theory ACodeOfAPlainFamilyGetsItsPhrase passes. Real code-5 rows read 'access denied'

criteria.criterion: 11. give a readable reason — when codes outside the families that real scans record or the Done-when names: 2, 362, 363, 1920, 1921, 4390-4394
criteria.how: AnotherCodeGetsWindowsOwnMessageAndItsNumber passes. Real 363 and 1920 rows show Windows' message plus '(Windows error N)'

criteria.criterion: 12. give a readable reason — when a code with no message-table entry: 9999, 15999, 65535
criteria.how: ACodeWithNoMessageStillNamesItsNumber passes, and so does the 1..16000 sweep

criteria.criterion: 13. give a readable reason — when the system message comes back empty or whitespace (injected lookup)
14. keep the view off the filesystem — when File.Exists planted in UnreadableRows.cs, with the Win32Exception call left in place
criteria.how: In the rules harness, F27 fires in both xunit and fitness while the clean baseline shows 0 hits. Fitness op=check holds all rules

obligations.evidence: Still open and owed to build-slice. fitness.yaml:249 still reads '(?m)\?\s*UnreadableKind\.(NothingListed|ListedPartway)\s*:' and ArchitectureRulesTests.cs:216 still reads '\?\s*UnreadableKind\.(NothingListed|ListedPartway)\s*:'. The trailing \s*: is not dropped, (?<!\?) is not added, and plants.json has no three-line ternary plant (only the one-line F29). HEAD is the same commit as build attempt 1 (0863450), so the fix was never made

Still open and owed to build-slice. I compiled the slice's UnreadableRows.cs into a scratch harness and sorted [C:\cs\readme\x, C:\cs\README\y, C:\cs\readme, C:\cs\README] with UnreadableRows.ComparePaths. Output: 'C:\cs\README | C:\cs\readme | C:\cs\readme\x | C:\cs\README\y', so README\y is separated from README. ComparePaths is unchanged, and the C-005 test still feeds only leaves

not_reached: A real folder listed partway (ListedPartway, 'only partly read'): none occurred in four real scans on this PC (matches U-098). That label was exercised only through the ScanFailingPartway failpoint on a real temp tree, and the opt-in SMB loopback rig (U-103 shape) was not run.

A folder that opened and then failed before its first entry (criterion 8): no test and no real instance. It would read 'could not be opened'. Whether the 28 real code-363 cloud rows under %TEMP%\fsa-guard-tests failed at open or at the first query is unmeasured.
Done-when #5's 'user's display language' on a machine whose display language is not English. This machine resolves every lookup to en-US, so a wrong-language lookup would look identical here.
Plain-phrase codes other than 5 (32/33 sharing and lock violations, the network and share family) on real folders: seen only through the unit table, never from a real scan.

Row text inside the shipped window: the --report schema serialises only the tab header ('Unreadable folders (570)') and the list's layout, not item text. The row text was observed by compiling the same UnreadableRows.cs source against the HEAD Core, not read out of the running exe.
A real case-sensitive directory on disk with case-variant failed folders (the O-023 shape). It was probed with synthetic paths only.
